LONG-STAY, five tests - all pass: (1) sells single nights online (ResNexus, 1-night search works); (2) transient sites are the majority - only sites 36-53 (18) are monthly-only, 26 sites came up bookable for one night; (3) open nights: 26 sites available Dec 8-9, 2026; (4) the site markets 'a night or two, or even a week, or month' - transient first, not seasonal/residential; (5) RV Life reviews from 2026 are overnight travellers (pull-through, $47-55 a night). KEEP.
